verdict.rationale: Granola Chat lets you ask natural-language questions about your meetings and get answers from notes or transcripts. It can be run from the home screen across all meetings, a single meeting, or a folder, which covers the cross-history query core of the story. The docs never show that Chat answers cite or link the meetings they came from; the magnifying-glass source tracing applies to AI-enhanced notes, not Chat answers. missing for 10: documented source citations in Chat answers, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-history answer quality
